todos.description: The agent's current whole todo list (the latest `todo/write` snapshot), or `null` before the first write. Whole-value rule: every `todo/write` carries the complete replacement list, so the fold is last-wins.

content.description: What this task is — a short imperative line shown in the UI.

status.description: Lifecycle state. `in_progress` marks a task being worked now; parallel work may mark several.

sessionListMetadata.description: Persisted facts used to summarize a Session without activating it.

blank.description: Whether the folded prefix contains no turn.

lastPromptAt.description: Latest human-authored prompt time in the folded prefix.

imageLimits.description: Image-intake limits enforced by the Session prompt endpoint.

maxImageDimension.description: Maximum intrinsic width and maximum intrinsic height in pixels for one image.

modelSelection.description: Durable model selection already used and selected for the next request.

lastUsed.description: Selection consumed by the latest recorded model request.

next.description: Selection the next request should use, falling back to {@link lastUsed}.

permissions.description: The session's current permission, folded from the three whole-value knob events (`permission/preset`, `sandbox/mode`, `approval/policy`) over the composition defaults. Selectable options come from the process-level catalog Remote. Key absence means no permission service is composed — clients hide the control.

currentValue.description: The effective current value: a configured preset key, `auto`, or `custom`.

subagentCatalog.description: Direct children in parent catalog event order, excluding fork-inherited facts.

subagentTiming.description: Active-turn duration and latest closed-turn completion for a descriptor-backed subagent session.

settledMs.description: Milliseconds accumulated across completed turns after the child's own descriptor.

active.description: Same-cut bounds of the currently open turn, when one has not reached `turn/end`.

through.description: Latest event time folded into this projection cut.

lastTurnCompleted.description: Whether the latest closed turn after the child's own descriptor completed normally; absent while a turn is open or before one closes.

subagent.description: Identity of a descriptor-backed subagent session. `null` ⟺ no valid descriptor (missing, malformed, or unrecognized-version — deliberately undistinguished). The sentinel is deliberately serializable: a value pushed over JSON transports must survive `JSON.stringify` losslessly, where an `undefined` field would be dropped and a stale identity would survive on the receiving side. The entry itself stays non-optional.

label.description: Optional durable creation label from the child's descriptor.

seq.description: Seq of the `subagent/descriptor` event this identity was folded from. `session.isOwnSeq(seq)` proves the identity comes from the child's OWN log suffix — where a descriptor is immutable once appended — and not from a fork seed's replayed ancestor descriptor.

label.description: Durable creation label from the child's descriptor.

seq.description: Seq of the folded descriptor event; see the one-shot arm for the own-suffix proof.

tokenUsage.description: Provider-reported usage accumulated across the complete durable log.

contextPressure.description: Newest request pressure paired with the newest known route capacity.

pressureTokens.description: Provider-reported prompt size of the most recent request: uncached input plus cache reads and writes. Response output is excluded, so this does not grow as the current turn streams. Absent until a provider reports usage.

projectedTokens.description: What the NEXT request's prompt would cost: {@link pressureTokens} plus the heuristic repricing of everything the surface gained or lost since that sample. Only the delta is estimated, so the figure stays anchored to the provider while still reacting the moment a compaction shadows a span — which `pressureTokens` alone cannot do, since compaction reports no usage of its own. Absent until a provider reports usage.

contextWindow.description: Newest recorded route capacity; absent when no adapter advertised one.

contextBreakdown.description: Heuristic system/tools/message composition of the next request.

systemTokens.description: Heuristic tokens of the last nonempty surviving system prompt in surface order; 0 when none exists.

toolsTokens.description: Heuristic tokens of the newest request envelope's tool schemas; 0 before any request.

messageTokens.description: Heuristic tokens of every other visible surface node, including superseded system prompts.

agentTeam.description: Durable roster and non-deleted task board of the Team rooted at the projected Session.

phase.description: Durable lifecycle; the Lead row is always `active`. Turn activity comes from Session status.

userQuestions.description: Timed questions that remain answerable in this Session, and the ones a late reply settled.

active.description: Calls that can still take an answer, in ask order.

id.description: Stable caller-provided question id, echoed in the answer.

detail.description: Optional supporting detail rendered with the question but kept out of option labels.

options.description: Optional choices the UI can render as a menu.

description.description: Optional extra context rendered by capable UIs.

multiSelect.description: Whether more than one option may be selected. Defaults to single-select.

intent.description: Optional presentation intent for capable UIs; absent asks for the generic option list.

kind.description: A plan submitted for review: `detail` is the plan markdown `ask()` requires, and the decision approves or declines it.

approve.description: The option label that approves the plan; every other option declines it. Named rather than positional so no UI infers the verdict from option order. An `approve` naming no option of its own question is rejected at `ask()`.

callId.description: Logged tool invocation whose arguments contain the reviewed plan.

settled.description: Calls an answer settled, in settlement order.

answers.description: The recorded batch, one entry per question; empty when the late reply carried none.

selected.description: Selected option labels. May accompany custom text for a multi-select question.

goal.description: The session's current goal and admitted-round count, or `null` before the first create and after a clear tombstone. `goal/change` supplies the whole lifecycle value; matching admitted `user/message` events advance `roundsStarted`.
Current durable goal snapshot (the CAS ref for mutations rides on it).

code.description: Stable lower-kebab-case classification chosen by the blocking policy.

message.description: Non-empty explanation shown to humans and models.

revision.description: Positive revision; every durable mutation increments it.

roundsStarted.description: Highest admitted round number for this goal.

createdAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the create mutation.

updatedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the latest mutation.

plan.description: Plan collaboration state folded from the plan command lifecycle and `plan/mode` events.

requestId.description: Client-minted identity persisted on the exact accepted user message.

content.description: At least one non-whitespace text part or attachment.

cwd.description: Initial working directory; shell directory changes do not update this field.

maxBytes.description: Maximum complete encoded frame bytes waiting for the Host consumer.

frameOverheadBytes.description: UTF-8 envelope bytes added to a compact JSON item with a present value field.

cwd.description: Initial working directory; shell directory changes do not update this field.

shellPath.description: A path returned by shell discovery; absent selects the execution default.

cwd.description: Initial working directory; shell directory changes do not update this field.
Logged current directory, read without filesystem validation.

maxBufferedBytes.description: Maximum complete encoded Client input bytes retained until acknowledgement.

cwd.description: Initial working directory; shell directory changes do not update this field.

selected.description: Selected option labels. May accompany custom text for a multi-select question.

answers.description: Structured answers keyed by question id.

stopActivity.description: Stop the Session's running work — its turn, subagent descendants, owned background jobs, and active schedules — instead of refusing the archive as `workspace/session-active`. The stops are requested before the archive write and are not awaited; the response arrives once the archive set is durable.
